text:
maria: Heads-up — the architecture diagram on /docs/runtime/serving.md is returning a 403 (S3 asset). Also the inline API example there is the old client call. @kevin @oliver can one of you swap in the new SVG and bump the snippet? I can volunteer to PR if you don't have bandwidth. :wave:

kevin: Which file exactly? serving.md under runtime? I can take a look in a bit. Do we want the SVG in public assets or keep it in the private bucket?

link-checker-bot: Link check failed: 403 on https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-docs/diagrams/inference-v1.png — found in /docs/runtime/serving.md line ~42

oliver: Yep that file. We replaced the diagram last May; looks like the public copy got rotated out. I can upload the new SVG to s3://redwood-docs-assets/diagrams/inference-v2.svg. Alt text idea: "Redwood serving runtime components and smart routing"

sara: If someone is updating the API snippet please switch it to the new Responses API example we merged (client.responses.create) and call out streaming vs non-streaming behavior. Also add a short note about `max_tokens` behaviour.

maria: Thanks. If @kevin can do the upload + PR that'd be ideal. I can run a local preview: `yarn dev` then `npx @redwood/docs-preview` to sanity-check. Also we should update the caption/license line under the diagram.

kevin: I will try to upload and open a PR today. Quick plan: upload SVG to public assets, update markdown image URL to the new path, update alt text, update code block to the Responses API snippet, run the docs preview locally, then open PR. Assigning to myself.

link-checker-bot: CI docs-preview: preview build for branch kevin/swap-diagram failed — broken image path: 403 fetching s3://redwood-docs-assets/diagrams/inference-v2.svg (permissions)

oliver: Kevin — ping me if you need me to push the SVG to the public bucket. I have the deploy creds and can set ACLs.

kevin: Thanks, Oliver. I hit the permission error; Oliver, can you push to public and confirm path?

oliver: Done — uploaded to https://assets.redwood.ai/docs/diagrams/inference-v2.svg and set public read.

kevin: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4392 — small changes: new image path, alt text, updated Responses API snippet, note about streaming. Can reviewers take a quick look?

sara: LGTM overall, left one tiny wording nit in the snippet comment (prefer `await` example). Also reword the caption to include attribution.

maria: Thanks! @docs-bot can you re-run the preview once this merges? :pray:

docs-bot: Will do. Manual trigger available: `/docs rebuild-pr 4392`. I will also auto-run on merge.

maria: Merging now since Sara approved. Merged at 1866668400.

kevin: Confirmed the image loads on the live preview and the new snippet renders correctly. Closing thread — thanks everyone.
